text:
Before Athena queues a fix request from a rejection (the error review's proposed request, a repeated-cause request, or a retry built from one), require the request to cite the record that shows the cause: a failed check's output, a verifier finding, or a file and line in the current tree. Refuse it with a stated reason when it cites none, when the cited record contradicts the claim, or when the tree already does what the fix adds. Acceptance: a test replays the recorded proposals that led to jobs 20261110-151108-70nx and 20261110-163344-3gaa and shows both are refused with a reason. A proposal that cites a real verifier finding still queues. cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test pass. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: The error review queues fix requests whose stated cause no record shows, so each rejection breeds the next one on the same false premise
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: CHANGELOG.md
